article.title: Penalty for not wearing protective headgear.
article.content: Whoever drives a motor cycle or causes or allows a motor cycle to be driven in contravention of the provisions of section 129 or the rules or regulations made thereunder shall be 4[liable for a penalty] of one thousand rupees and he shall be disqualified for holding licence for a period of three months.
article.html:
194DPenalty for not wearing protective headgear.

Section 194D · Chapter XIII · page 107 of the Act

Whoever drives a motor cycle or causes or allows a motor cycle to be driven in contravention of the provisions of section 129 or the rules or regulations made thereunder shall be 4[liable for a penalty] of one thousand rupees and he shall be disqualified for holding licence for a period of three months.

4 Subs. by Act 8 of 2026, s. 2 and Sch. for “punishable with a fine” (w.e.f. 15-8-2026).
